opening.argument: The video presents BitClub membership and mining-pool participation as an earning opportunity, beginning with an invitation to join that carries a $99 activation fee. It then claims that connection to the pool brings daily payouts for 1000 or 2000 days, and describes how a paid, activated member can be placed in the binary structure by a sponsor. That is a specific return proposition tied to purchasing membership and mining shares, not merely a description of mining. The video also shows a wallet amount entered in an instructional Bitcoin payment flow. The evidence does not establish that payment was completed or that payouts occurred; the claim rests on the opportunity and payment process the video presents.

citations.quote: When you join the mining pool, a $99 activation fee will be charged
Once connected to the pool, you have mining with a daily payout for 1000 or 2000 days
Once the membership is paid and activated, the member can be placed in the binary structure by the sponsor
